हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/QEXh97
show.description: When Nandini—president of Indus Airlines—catches her husband cheating, he doesn’t just deny it… he erases her. Trapped on a private jet, branded an “impostor,” and watching her daughter suffer, she’s nearly broken—until a quiet cabin crewman steps in, risking everything to protect her. Now Nandini must choose: disappear like he wants… or bring him down with the one ally he never saw coming.
